I4.evidence: The selected config enables interval acceptance and static certificates. In snapshots/initial_full/model.py, compilation updates cutoff[b]=tree.right[t] before reading cutoff[a], storing (L[a],L[a]+1,q,U[a]) and successor-length offsets, matching Algorithm 1. Certification uses context=W_state[:-off] and universally checks vocabulary tokens satisfying word.endswith(context) or context.endswith(word), matching K(C); defaults enforce 64 eligible states and 256 attempted pairs. append() uses decreasing-length candidates, requires n-off>0, bypasses history membership only for certified pairs, and otherwise executes the exact two-interval predicate. Dense transitions, atomic-only shortcuts, token-ID history, reconstruction, and absence of runtime acceptance caching match the manuscript. The reported selected validation value rounds to 2.7824. Imported automaton/forest internals and timing results were not independently verified because the audit was restricted to the selected source and config.
